name: Marshall University
academic_ranking: Public research university founded in 1837. Ranked #318 of 436 National Universities in the U.S. News 2026 Best Colleges edition. Recognized for programs including computer science and cyber security.
financial_aid: Public institution. Out-of-state tuition and fees approx. $20,342/yr; in-state (WV resident) approx. $9,162/yr (2024-25). Athletic scholarships available through the softball program; academic and need-based aid available through the university. Confirm current athletic aid directly with the coaching staff.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at Dot Hicks Field on the Marshall University campus in Huntington, WV.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Sun Belt Conference (moved from Conference USA in 2022). Led by head coach Morgan Zerkle, a former Marshall All-American. Program refreshed its coaching staff for the 2026 season.
notes: Athletics content is hosted on herdzone.com (goherd.com refused direct connections during research on 2026-07). Coaching staff confirmed via herdzone.com news 'Herd Softball Finalizes 2026 Staff' (2025-07-23) and program social announcements. The staff directory and roster pages are JavaScript-rendered and did not expose emails, phones, twitter handles, or a countable roster list to automated fetching; roster_size and scholarship_count left null. Tuition and rankings sourced from public 2024-26 data. No data invented.
